What is shipping software

A tool that helps automate and optimize your order shipping process by comparing carrier rates, printing labels, and syncing with your sales channels.

What is shipping software?

A tool that helps automate and optimize your order shipping process by comparing carrier rates, printing labels, and syncing with your sales channels.

How does your platform save me money?

We offer pre-negotiated carrier rates and always select the cheapest shipping option— no hidden fees, no hassle, just shipping. 

Are there monthly or user fees?

Nope. Our platform is free to use with zero monthly or per-user charges.

Can I automate my shipping process?

Yes. You can build custom rules to automate label printing, packing slips, carrier selection, and more.

Does it work with my store or marketplace?

Yes. We integrate with all major eCommerce platforms and marketplaces—Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce, and more.
